objective.title: FU-025: skill files are read with the skill directory path, never relative to the working directory

nodes.title: Skill paths: CB-6 and DL-036 in dev-core; dev-retro (Skill paths, capture steps 3 and 4, review step 3); the sentence in each other dev-* skill; prefixes for pack files named without one; README; records
